pages.text: Here are two ready-to-copy configurations. Paste each snippet into the matching file, then restart the server or the world so the new values are read.

$(l)Preset 1: Classic ProjectE.$() This restores the pre-balance feel. You do not need to list every balance.* key, because setting balance.enabled = false already makes the mod use the legacy value of all of them. Only the classic keys that changed need to be set back by hand.$(br2)server.toml:$(br2)[balance]$(br)enabled = false$(br2)[items]$(br)enableTimeWatch = true$(br2)[difficulty]$(br)katarDeathAura = 1000.0$(br)covalenceLoss = 1.0

$(l)Preset 2: Hardcore survival.$() This one is a $(l)suggestion$(), not a supported default. It keeps the balance system on and makes it far stricter: effects cost more EMC, abilities are disabled in the Nether and the End, armor wears out, EMC generation is a fraction of normal and automation is capped. Adjust or remove anything you dislike, and trim the dimension blacklist if you still want abilities there.$(br2)server.toml:$(br2)[balance]$(br)enabled = true$(br)effectEmcMultiplier = 2.0$(br)dimensionBlacklist = ["minecraft:the_nether", "minecraft:the_end"]

[balance.emc]$(br)generationMultiplier = 0.1$(br)condenserCostMultiplier = 3.0$(br2)[balance.entropySinks]$(br)efficiencyFloor = 0.1$(br2)[balance.stellarCondenser]$(br)softCapPerMinute = 128$(br2)[balance.matterFurnaces]$(br)dmDoubleOreChance = 0.1$(br)rmDoubleOreChance = 0.0$(br2)[balance.mercurialEye]$(br)maxArea = 16$(br2)[balance.lens]$(br)maxRadius = 4.0$(br2)[balance.timeWatch]$(br)inventoryBonus = 0$(br2)The default balance.collectors.sunOnly = true already applies, so collectors only work in daylight and there is no need to repeat it.
